blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats for 4 or 7 hours to explore local waters including Shell Key, Johns Pass, and sandbars. Captained snorkeling cruises to Egmont Key or Shell Key are offered, as well as private sunset cruises. Boats feature amenities like USB charging, Garmin GPS, and shaded seating areas.
